subject: Renewal discussion: phased multi-year lockstep and exit clauses
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@arcadiahealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@arcadiahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal discussion: initial framing and options

Hi Samantha / Arcadia procurement team,

Thanks again for the productive QBR yesterday. As we discussed, I wanted to kick off a short thread to surface a few structured options for the upcoming renewal so your team can evaluate commercial and operational impacts quickly. High-level goals you mentioned: predictable unit economics for 2029, ability to scale capacity in year 1 as usage ramps, and a clear exit path if performance or compliance needs aren't met.

Options we'd like your feedback on (short):
- Option A: 2-year lockstep (co-term) with staged capacity increases at months 0, 6, 12; modest annual price escalator.
- Option B: 3-year phased commit (annualized credits but front-loaded ramp credits) with an opt-out window after 12 months (formal notice required).
- Option C: 12-month initial term + optional 24-month auto-renew with pre-agreed scale triggers (falls back to our hosted tier if thresholds not met).

Questions for you:
1) Is Arcadia comfortable with an opt-out after 12 months, or do you need shorter notice?
2) Any constraints on co-terming with other vendor contracts?
3) What payment cadence does procurement prefer (annual prepay / quarterly invoicing / milestone-based)?

I looped in Marissa (AE) to attach a quick draft SOW and a sample clause for a 12-month exit/notice window. If it helps, we can schedule a 30-min alignment call next week to walk through one preferred path and legal redlines.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@arcadiahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@arcadiahealth.com>, Arcadia Health Legal <legal@arcadiahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Jul 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion: initial framing and options

Hi Karthik,

Appreciate the concise options. Quick notes from our side after an internal sync:
- Preference: Option B (3-year phased commit) looks appealing because it gives us budget predictability while allowing capacity to grow.
- Opt-out: We can agree to an opt-out at month 12 but need a 90-day notice window (so effectively notify by month 9).
- Compliance checkpoint: Legal wants the ability to pause rollout if a SOC/controls review raises flags; they suggested a 30-day remediation window rather than immediate termination.
- Payments: Preference for quarterly invoicing tied to committed capacity, with a true-up at year-end.

Can Marissa send the SOW and sample clause language (including the remediation window and notice timing)? Also, procurement will likely redline payment cadence; I'll loop them in.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Director, Data Platforms
Arcadia Health

Subject: Arcadia renewal: draft SOW + phased ramp language (attachment)

Hi Samantha / Procurement,

Attached are two files: Arcadia_Renewal_Draft_20280724.pdf (commercial summary) and SOW_Phased_Ramp.xlsx (detailed ramp schedule + token bands). Key points in the draft:
- Structure: 36-month master with a 12-month firm commitment (year 1), optional continuation years 2-3 with pre-agreed scale triggers.
- Opt-out: Customer may elect to opt-out after month 12 by providing 90 days' written notice; if notice is given, services continue through the 12-month term and then wind-down over the subsequent 30 days.
- Remediation: If compliance or security findings occur, Arcadia has a 30-day remediation window; Redwood provides technical support and can temporarily restrict new deployment capacity during that window.
- Payment: Quarterly invoicing for committed capacity with a year-end true-up; overage billed monthly.

Attachment stubs:
- Arcadia_Renewal_Draft_20280724.pdf (application/pdf)
- SOW_Phased_Ramp.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Next steps I suggest:
1) Procurement to send redlines to this thread (we can accept tracked changes).
2) If legal requests minor contract language changes, we can mark them as "non-substantive" for the commercial terms and proceed to signature.
3) If you prefer, we can send a DocuSign envelope for the commercial terms once redlines are reconciled: https://www.docusign.com/en/sign?envelopeId=abc123-arca-2028

Happy to hop on a 30-min call — Jordan and I are available Thursday or Friday afternoon.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Procurement Team <procurement@arcadiahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@arcadiahealth.com>, Arcadia Health Legal <legal@arcadiahealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jul 2028 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Arcadia - redlines and payment cadence request

Marissa / Karthik,

Thanks for the draft. Attached are our markups (Arcadia_Redlines_20280726.docx) — summary of requested changes below:
- Payment cadence: prefer semi-annual invoicing tied to milestones (50% at start of each 6-month block) rather than quarterly.
- Exit clause: require a 60-day remediation window (Arcadia Legal prefers longer) and explicit service-level credits if remediation fails.
- Auto-renew: we need an explicit opt-in for years 2-3 rather than automatic renewal; otherwise, we want a notification 120 days before renewal.
- Data retention: require 18 months of log retention for audit purposes (we can discuss cost impact).

Can Redwood confirm whether the semi-annual payment cadence introduces any discounts or changes to the pricing bands? Also, please confirm whether the proposed 18-month log retention is available as an add-on.

Attachment stub: Arcadia_Redlines_20280726.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

Regards,
Arcadia Health Procurement

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@arcadiahealth.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@arcadiahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2028 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Arcadia - redlines and payment cadence request

Thanks for the clear redlines. Quick confirm and proposed next steps:

- Semi-annual invoicing: we can support semi-annual milestones. In exchange, we can offer a 2.5% billing discount on committed capacity bands (applied pro-rata). I'll ask finance to model the precise $ impact and share the updated quote by EOD Wed.
- Exit / remediation window: we can extend remediation to 60 days and include the service-level credits you requested as a fallback.
- Auto-renew: we will convert years 2-3 to explicit opt-in with a 120-day notification, per your ask.
- Log retention: 18-month audit log retention is available as a paid add-on; Marissa will include pricing in the updated SOW.

If that matches your expectation, let's schedule a 30-min call tomorrow (Wed 08:30 AM PT / 11:30 AM ET preferred) to walk the redlines and lock the commercial terms. Once we align, we'll send an updated SOW + tracked contract for legal, then a DocuSign for signature.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/ARC-2028-07-24

Best,
Karthik
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
